no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee meeting was not held as the drug is not the first in its class and the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for this class in the intended population.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for PARSABIV (etelcalcetide, NDA208325). The FDA Summary Review states an AdComm was not held because the drug is not first-in-class and the application raised no unexpected safety or efficacy issues for its class and population; the Medical Review's Advisory Committee section likewise records 'None'. Accordingly there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
